parsed_json.up: Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, and to compound_structures on molregno as an inner join. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL1217644, keeping only rows where standard_value is not null, standard_relation is not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Do not deduplicate; return all qualifying activity rows. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
